description: Pedestrian Footfall DLR is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Pedestrian footfall counts at a number of locations within the Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council administrative area. Pedestrian counts are available from seven locations throughout the county, each of which records bidirectional pedestrian traffic.
